\begin{document}
This note records two freshman algebra identities. It is a synthetic
public demo, not a research manuscript.

The binomial square
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:binomial-left}
(x+1)^{2}
\end{equation}
equals the expanded polynomial
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:binomial-right}
x^{2} + 2x + 1.
\end{equation}

Distributivity of multiplication over addition gives
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:twice-left}
2(x+1)
\end{equation}
equal to
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:twice-right}
2x + 2.
\end{equation}
\end{document}
